items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Then I left Pansy and I went to work with Dan Hughes.

ctx.x: And he played, after that you went with the Majada Brothers, with the Triangle Band. You used to play for Lou Rose.

I played with Jack Lane's Old Reliance Band. That was the first band I ever worked with. Jack Lane's Old Reliance Band. Then I worked with Pansy Lane. Then I left Pansy and I went to work with Dan Hughes. We used to advertise for Lou Rose's Burles show by walking around Canal Street two hours every evening. And that, that, oh that went on for about two years. We used to advertise every night from, from eight, from six to eight. Walking around Canal Street. I had some pictures of that around here, but I don't know…
I can't give you them, that's why I said it's here.
